**Pre-release — not production-ready.**

## Unth Recover v0.2.0-alpha — Self-hosted Community Edition (M1) + web panel (M2 preview)

Everything from v0.1.0-alpha (backups proven by a real isolated restore; a backup is `VERIFIED`
only after every mandatory check passed) plus:

### New
- **`unth run`** — the job to schedule: per-job lock → backup → verify → retention → notify
- **Retention** (`unth prune`): keep_last / keep_daily / keep_weekly / max_age; the newest VERIFIED backup is never expired
- **Notifications**: JSON webhook (HMAC-SHA256 signed) and Slack; URLs and keys only from environment variables
- **Docker volume backups** (`unth backup volume`) with consistency policies `offline` / `stop` and per-file verification in an isolated volume
- **Web panel** (`unth serve`): overview, backups with the Created → Integrity checked → Restore tested → Verified pipeline, reports with suggested fixes, Verify now, activity log; token login, TLS required off-loopback
- **Packages**: `.deb` (systemd units, `unth` user), container image `ghcr.io/unmadethings/unthrecover:v0.2.0-alpha` (PostgreSQL clients 13–17), checksum-verified `install.sh`
- **Version-matched client tools**: unth picks the `pg_dump`/`pg_restore` of each source's major version (fixes restores from client 17 into PostgreSQL ≤ 16)

### Tested
CI: PostgreSQL 12–17 integration matrix, browser test of the panel, `.deb` install in a clean
container, the container image backing up and verifying PostgreSQL 12/16/17 and a volume, installer
tests, govulncheck, gosec, gitleaks. Details: docs/TEST_RESULTS.md.

### Known limitations
- Linux only; backups are not encrypted and checksums are not signatures
- Single admin token for the panel (no roles yet); sessions are in memory
- Roles/privileges are not verified; Docker socket access is root-equivalent

### Install
```bash
curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unmadethings/unthrecover/main/scripts/install.sh
sudo sh install.sh --version v0.2.0-alpha
```
Or: `sudo apt install ./unthrecover_0.2.0~alpha_amd64.deb` · `docker pull ghcr.io/unmadethings/unthrecover:v0.2.0-alpha`
